head_commit.message:
Submissions: a bound may have up to 40 digits per integer (was 18)

Issue #35 (2026-10-21): the submitter's reduced 3SUM bound 4800698571997281331/2500000000000000000 needs 19 digits in each integer, and the 18-digit limit refused it. Nil decision (2026-10-21): 40 digits per integer here and in the site importer; all other checks unchanged. The bound stays an exact Fraction in the gate and exact integers in the generated Lean target (byte-identical to the site's challenge_bytes for 19 and 40 digits). Tests accept 19 and 40 digits and reject 41.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
